data.title: Lido Unveils Curated Module v2 in Ethereum Staking Overhaul | The Defiant
data.description: Lido, the largest Ethereum staking protocol by total value locked, launched Curated Module v2, a new version of its main staking module that for the first time requires professional node operators to back the stake they manage with their own capital, the team said in a blog post published Monday.
data.author: The Defiant Team
